strategy.primary: Cast-trigger reanimator: put premium creatures in the graveyard early (Entomb, Buried Alive, loots), accelerate the eight-mana commander, and cast Sauron to amass 5, mill 5 and return the best creature, even if Sauron is countered.
strategy.secondary: Cheap secondary reanimation when Sauron isn't available, Anger/Wonder for haste and flying from the graveyard, and the Nazgûl/Ring/Orc package for pressure.
